headline: Palestinians grieve for a father-to-be shot by Israeli troops the day his son was born
context: Nayef Samaro, 25, was killed in an Israeli military raid on Nablus, in the occupied West Bank, as he prepared to meet his wife at the hospital for the birth of their first child.
